description: Online pwn helpers: identify libc from leaked offsets, look up GTFOBins, grab shellcode.

tools.name: libc-database (blukat)
tools.desc: Identify the exact libc from one or more leaked symbol offsets, then get other offsets

tools.name: libc.rip
tools.desc: libc identification API/UI from leaked offsets; dumps all symbol addresses for the match

tools.name: GTFOBins
tools.desc: How a given Unix binary can break out, read files or escalate (setuid/sudo/PATH abuse)

tools.name: shell-storm shellcodes
tools.desc: Archive of ready shellcodes by arch/OS when you need bytes instead of writing them
